purpose: Bounded development escape test of the frozen M4-07 actor family, varying only eta and tau_e. Owner authorized choosing and proceeding on 2026-09-22. Written before sweep execution.
inherit: Base profile, actor family, development root 1, outers 1-3, lifetime 0, 2000 outcomes, first/final 100 exposures per cue, and criterion verbatim from reference_plan; override only eta and tau_e.
grid_order: eta-major, tau_e-minor; index 7 is the (0.001, 32) replication anchor
execution_order: Run 3 continuous B3 controls and all 3 anchor B4 lifetimes first. Compare every archived aggregate record field exactly; halt on any mismatch. Then remaining points in grid order, outers ascending. Each declared lifetime runs once.
control_reuse: One fresh continuous B3 per outer shared across 12 points; no plastic state or eta/tau_e dependence. Fast pairing fixtures verify this across the grid.
selection: Eligible only if the inherited absolute criterion passes on at least 2/3 seeds, all 39 lifetimes complete without failure and integrity checks pass, and every passing seed meets the descriptive mechanism screen. Rank by most passing seeds, highest minimum-across-all-seeds margin, smallest abs(log2(eta/0.001))+abs(log2(tau_e/32)), then lowest grid index.

mechanism.late_window: union of the final 100 exposures of each cue, identical to accuracy windows
mechanism.required_on_each_passing_seed: Both actions occur at least once over the lifetime, and late mean abs(delta) exceeds 1e-12. This is a conservative descriptive screen, not a causal or generalization proof; a screen failure prevents automatic adoption.
mechanism.report: Lifetime and late action counts; late mean abs(delta), eligibility L1 and actual update L1; raw identity max error; all per-outcome scalar series and inherited M4-07 diagnostics. Successful learning can itself reduce delta, so this screen is not a universal learning criterion.

budget.execution: serial release, fresh directory only; preflight small fixtures are separate engineering checks

guardrails: No production changes, hidden resets, decay, membrane clipping, learned decoders, gate changes, actor/input/motor tuning, extra seeds, validation/final-test inspection, or post-result retuning. Save failures; missing or interrupted output is not a null.
on_pass: Adopt the deterministic screened winner provisionally as the M4 persistent development family; record departure from M3-08, preserve M4-07 negative result, and require replay verification for new settings and a separately declared fresh-development confirmation before broader claims. Do not automatically check M4-GATE.
on_no_pass: Adopt nothing. Save an honest negative M4-09 evidence bundle and design-escalation entry; M4-07 and M4-GATE remain open. No follow-up tuning in this run.
scope_rationale: Joint eta/tau tuning is motivated by spec 7.9 and the proposed M5 ranges, but this is a stationary-clean M4 diagnostic. Omitting tau_e 128 bounds cost given no rescue at 16/32/64 at eta 0.001; this does not establish monotonic failure. Keep input and motor fixed for attribution, not because weaker drive or altered filtering has been disproved.
claim_limits: Reusing development seeds answers only this frozen-grid question. An absolute bar and deterministic replay do not remove selection bias or stochastic false positives. Outer 3 B3=0.875 leaves maximum margin 0.125, below 0.15, so both locked outers 1 and 2 must pass. A null excludes only these 12 settings on these 3 lifetimes, not the algorithm or all fixed-rule settings.
